title: Animation Tree Node causes strange behavior with the Animation Player and sprite2D.
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: Godot 4.6 RC1

### System information

Godot v4.6.rc1 - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) HD Graphics 4400 (HSW GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-4160 CPU @ 3.60GHz (4 threads) - 11.55 GiB memory

### Issue description

The animation tree node seems to be causing problems with the animation player node and the 2D sprite node. It appears that the animation tree is preventing other nodes from working if they are being modified within an animation in the animation player.

Things like changing the sprite texture or frames don't seem to affect them if they are being modified within an animation in the animation player. If, after selecting the animation player tree, I choose the animation dock and then select another animation that isn't affecting the value I want to change, I can change that value without problems, such as changing the texture of the 2D sprite node.

I don't know if this behavior is intentional, but I think it complicates things considerably if it is. The output still sends the message that the texture was changed, not to mention that the animation player sometimes throws errors.

A video demonstrating the problem:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0663f60f-fbab-4143-b5e0-068989dc4677

My apologies if this is intentional, it just looks like strange behavior.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new project.

Create a simple scene with the animation player, animation tree, and 2D sprite nodes.

Create an animation that changes certain properties of the 2D sprite.

It will not be possible to change these properties to other values, even if the animation is paused.
